stem: A plant that is described as a mesophyte has evolved to grow in conditions that do not normally experience water stress (low availability of water).

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Fig. 5.1 is a diagram of a cross section through the leaf of a herbaceous dicotyledonous mesophyte.

Complete Fig. 5.1 by naming structure **A** and tissue layer **B**.
